newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: American killed in Swiss mountain plunge.
newsitem.headline: American killed in Swiss mountain plunge.

text.p: A 22-year-old American fell to his death after a ski outing in western Switzerland, police in the canton of Valais said on Wednesday.
A police spokesman declined to identify the man, who lived in the German town of Pohlheim, north of Frankfurt.

Police said the accident occurred on Monday afternoon near the village of Loeche-les-Bains when the man decided to take a short cut while hiking back alone from a ski trip. He slipped down an embankment and plunged into a gorge.
Search teams recovered the body late on Tuesday.
